from aws_cli import run, result

ROOT = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd')
OUT = ROOT / 'testdata/aws/sns/encryption_s3_source.json'
ACCOUNT = '000000000000'
REGION = 'us-east-1'
NAME = 'stackd-sns-s3ctx-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
TOPIC = f'arn:aws:sns:{REGION}:{ACCOUNT}:{NAME}'
BUCKET = NAME
BUCKET_ARN = 'arn:aws:s3:::' + BUCKET
QUEUE_ARN = f'arn:aws:sqs:{REGION}:{ACCOUNT}:{NAME}'
ENV = dict(os.environ, AWS_REGION=REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=REGION, AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1', AWS_RETRY_MODE='standard', AWS_PAGER='', AWS_IGNORE_CONFIGURED_ENDPOINT_URLS='true', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
for k in list(ENV):
    if k.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL'):
        del ENV[k]
now = lambda: int(time.time() * 1000)
iso = lambda ms: dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(ms / 1000, dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()
CAP = {'account': ACCOUNT, 'region': REGION, 'started_ms': now(), 'source_references': ['https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/grant-destinations-permissions-to-s3.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_PutBucketNotificationConfiguration.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/notification-content-structure.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-key-management.html'], 'source_revisions': {'stackd': '2f442632b489d753618aaff3d998b69967a3936e', 'aws_cli_sha256': hashlib.sha256((ROOT / 'scripts/aws/aws_cli.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}, 'observations': [], 'receipts': [], 'windows': [], 'cleanup': [], 'cloudtrail': {'events': [], 'lookups': []}, 'owned_resources': {'name': NAME, 'bucket': BUCKET, 'topic': TOPIC, 'keys': {}}, 'source': {'kind': 'Native AWS CLI through scripts/aws/aws_cli.py run/result; isolated capture, no IAM resources or trails', 'capture_script': Path(__file__).read_text()}, 'limitations': ['One owned bucket, encrypted standard SNS topic, raw unencrypted SQS subscriber in one account/region.', 'Positive source-bound authorization capture, not a negative authorization matrix. No conclusions from missing consumer receipts.', 'KMS events correlate by owned key, topic/source encryption context and bounded operation window; KMS does not include object key, ETag or S3 notification request ID. Only one object is uploaded after the second-key cutover.', 'Second CMK is never selected during notification validation. An explicit 330-second post-selection wait precedes the single object upload; actual use requires source-key KMS events, not attribute readback.']}
KEYS = {}
QUEUE = SUB = None
bucket_owned = topic_owned = False
BODY_PATH = Path('/tmp/' + NAME + '.body')

def scrub(v):
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return {k: '<redacted>' if k.lower() in ('secretaccesskey', 'sessiontoken', 'accesskeyid') else scrub(x) for k, x in v.items()}
    if isinstance(v, list):
        return [scrub(x) for x in v]

def save():
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(scrub(CAP), indent=2) + '\n')

def request(label, service, operation, parameters, cleanup=False, strict=True, options=(), recorded_input=None):

        entry['result'] = {'code': type(exc).__name__, 'message': str(exc)}

    CAP['cleanup' if cleanup else 'observations'].append(entry)
    save()
    print(label, entry['result']['code'], flush=True)
    if strict and entry['result']['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError(label + ': ' + str(entry['result']))
    return entry['result'].get('output', {})

def policy(service, action, resource, source):
    return json.dumps({'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': [{'Effect': 'Allow', 'Principal': {'Service': service}, 'Action': action, 'Resource': resource, 'Condition': {'ArnEquals': {'aws:SourceArn': source}, 'StringEquals': {'aws:SourceAccount': ACCOUNT}}}]})

def receive(phase, predicate):

        output = request('receive-' + phase, 'sqs', 'receive-message', {'QueueUrl': QUEUE, 'WaitTimeSeconds': 15, 'MaxNumberOfMessages': 10, 'MessageSystemAttributeNames': ['All'], 'MessageAttributeNames': ['All']})

    identity = request('identity', 'sts', 'get-caller-identity', {})
    if identity['Account'] != ACCOUNT:
        raise RuntimeError('Native account mismatch')
    for phase in ('validation', 'object'):

        KEYS[phase] = metadata

        request('read-' + phase + '-key-policy', 'kms', 'get-key-policy', {'KeyId': metadata['KeyId'], 'PolicyName': 'default'})
    request('create-topic', 'sns', 'create-topic', {'Name': NAME, 'Attributes': {'KmsMasterKeyId': KEYS['validation']['Arn']}})
    topic_owned = True
    request('topic-source-policy', 'sns', 'set-topic-attributes', {'TopicArn': TOPIC, 'AttributeName': 'Policy', 'AttributeValue': policy('s3.amazonaws.com', 'sns:Publish', TOPIC, BUCKET_ARN)})
    QUEUE = request('create-raw-unencrypted-queue', 'sqs', 'create-queue', {'QueueName': NAME, 'Attributes': {'SqsManagedSseEnabled': 'false'}})['QueueUrl']
    CAP['owned_resources']['queue'] = {'url': QUEUE, 'arn': QUEUE_ARN}
    request('queue-source-policy', 'sqs', 'set-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': QUEUE, 'Attributes': {'Policy': policy('sns.amazonaws.com', 'sqs:SendMessage', QUEUE_ARN, TOPIC)}})
    SUB = request('subscribe-raw', 'sns', 'subscribe', {'TopicArn': TOPIC, 'Protocol': 'sqs', 'Endpoint': QUEUE_ARN, 'Attributes': {'RawMessageDelivery': 'true'}, 'ReturnSubscriptionArn': True})['SubscriptionArn']
    CAP['owned_resources']['subscription'] = SUB
    request('read-subscription', 'sns', 'get-subscription-attributes', {'SubscriptionArn': SUB})
    request('read-queue', 'sqs', 'get-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': QUEUE, 'AttributeNames': ['All']})
    request('read-validation-topic', 'sns', 'get-topic-attributes', {'TopicArn': TOPIC})
    request('create-bucket', 's3api', 'create-bucket', {'Bucket': BUCKET})
    bucket_owned = True
    CAP['validation_started_ms'] = now()
    request('validate-bucket-notification', 's3api', 'put-bucket-notification-configuration', {'Bucket': BUCKET, 'NotificationConfiguration': {'TopicConfigurations': [{'Id': NAME, 'TopicArn': TOPIC, 'Events': ['s3:ObjectCreated:*']}]}})
    request('read-bucket-notification', 's3api', 'get-bucket-notification-configuration', {'Bucket': BUCKET})
    receive('validation', lambda event: event.get('Event') == 's3:TestEvent' and event.get('Bucket') == BUCKET)
    CAP['validation_ended_ms'] = now()
    request('select-cold-object-key', 'sns', 'set-topic-attributes', {'TopicArn': TOPIC, 'AttributeName': 'KmsMasterKeyId', 'AttributeValue': KEYS['object']['Arn']})
    request('read-object-topic-key-selection', 'sns', 'get-topic-attributes', {'TopicArn': TOPIC})
    wait_start = now()
    time.sleep(330)
    CAP['windows'].append({'kind': 'post-key-selection-wait', 'started_ms': wait_start, 'ended_ms': now(), 'requested_seconds': 330, 'purpose': 'Allow topic attribute propagation and prior SNS data-key reuse to elapse; not itself proof of second-key use.'})
    body = (NAME + '\nObjectCreated cold-key publication\n').encode('utf-8')
    object_key = 'cold-key/' + uuid.uuid4().hex + '.txt'
    BODY_PATH.write_bytes(body)
    CAP['object'] = {'bucket': BUCKET, 'key': object_key, 'body_utf8': body.decode(), 'body_base64': base64.b64encode(body).decode(), 'body_sha256': hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(), 'body_md5': hashlib.md5(body).hexdigest(), 'size': len(body)}
    params = {'Bucket': BUCKET, 'Key': object_key, 'ContentType': 'text/plain'}
    CAP['object_started_ms'] = now()
    put_output = request('put-object-after-cold-key-selection', 's3api', 'put-object', params, options=['--body', str(BODY_PATH)], recorded_input={**params, 'Body': body.decode()})
    CAP['observations'][-1]['input_encoding'] = {'Body': 'utf-8 bytes, preserved inline; native CLI transported these exact bytes via --body temporary-file'}
    CAP['object']['put_output'] = put_output
    request('head-created-object', 's3api', 'head-object', {'Bucket': BUCKET, 'Key': object_key})
    def matches_object(event):
        return any(record.get('eventName') == 'ObjectCreated:Put' and record.get('s3', {}).get('bucket', {}).get('name') == BUCKET and record.get('s3', {}).get('object', {}).get('key') == object_key and record['s3']['object'].get('eTag') == put_output['ETag'].strip('"') for record in event.get('Records', []))
    receive('object', matches_object)
    CAP['object_ended_ms'] = now()
except Exception as exc:
    CAP['capture_error'] = str(exc)
    print('CAPTURE ERROR', str(exc), flush=True)
finally:
    CAP['publication_window_ended_ms'] = now()
    if bucket_owned:
        request('remove-bucket-notification', 's3api', 'put-bucket-notification-configuration', {'Bucket': BUCKET, 'NotificationConfiguration': {}}, cleanup=True, strict=False)
        versions = request('list-owned-bucket-versions', 's3api', 'list-object-versions', {'Bucket': BUCKET}, cleanup=True, strict=False)
        for version in versions.get('Versions', []) + versions.get('DeleteMarkers', []):
            request('delete-owned-version', 's3api', 'delete-object', {'Bucket': BUCKET, 'Key': version['Key'], 'VersionId': version['VersionId']}, cleanup=True, strict=False)
        objects = request('list-owned-bucket-objects', 's3api', 'list-objects-v2', {'Bucket': BUCKET}, cleanup=True, strict=False)
        for obj in objects.get('Contents', []):
            request('delete-owned-object', 's3api', 'delete-object', {'Bucket': BUCKET, 'Key': obj['Key']}, cleanup=True, strict=False)
        request('verify-owned-bucket-versions-empty', 's3api', 'list-object-versions', {'Bucket': BUCKET}, cleanup=True, strict=False)
        request('verify-owned-bucket-objects-empty', 's3api', 'list-objects-v2', {'Bucket': BUCKET}, cleanup=True, strict=False)
        request('delete-bucket', 's3api', 'delete-bucket', {'Bucket': BUCKET}, cleanup=True, strict=False)
        request('verify-bucket-absent', 's3api', 'head-bucket', {'Bucket': BUCKET}, cleanup=True, strict=False)

        request('delete-topic', 'sns', 'delete-topic', {'TopicArn': TOPIC}, cleanup=True, strict=False)
        request('verify-topic-absent', 'sns', 'get-topic-attributes', {'TopicArn': TOPIC}, cleanup=True, strict=False)

        request('verify-queue-absent', 'sqs', 'get-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': QUEUE, 'AttributeNames': ['QueueArn']}, cleanup=True, strict=False)
    for phase, key in KEYS.items():
        request('schedule-' + phase + '-key-deletion', 'kms', 'schedule-key-deletion', {'KeyId': key['KeyId'], 'PendingWindowInDays': 7}, cleanup=True, strict=False)
        request('verify-' + phase + '-key-pending-deletion', 'kms', 'describe-key', {'KeyId': key['KeyId']}, cleanup=True, strict=False)
    BODY_PATH.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    save()

# LookupEvents does not require a trail; scope lookups to the two owned keys.
poll_start = now()
end_ms = CAP['publication_window_ended_ms'] + 1000
CAP['cloudtrail']['window'] = {'start': iso(CAP['started_ms'] - 5000), 'end': iso(end_ms), 'poll_started_ms': poll_start, 'maximum_poll_seconds': 900}
deadline = time.monotonic() + 900
seen = set()
missing = []
while time.monotonic() < deadline:
    for phase, key in KEYS.items():
        token = None
        while True:
            parameters = {'LookupAttributes': [{'AttributeKey': 'ResourceName', 'AttributeValue': key['KeyId']}], 'StartTime': iso(CAP['started_ms'] - 5000), 'EndTime': iso(end_ms), 'MaxResults': 50}
            if token:
                parameters['NextToken'] = token
            started = now()
            response = result(run('cloudtrail', 'lookup-events', parameters, ENV, options=['--no-paginate', '--cli-connect-timeout', '10', '--cli-read-timeout', '30'], timeout=45))
            ended = now()
            output = response.get('output', {})
            matched_ids = []
            for lookup_event in output.get('Events', []):
                event = json.loads(lookup_event['CloudTrailEvent'])
                if event.get('eventSource') != 'kms.amazonaws.com' or not any(resource.get('ARN') == key['Arn'] for resource in event.get('resources', [])):
                    continue
                matched_ids.append(event['eventID'])
                if event['eventID'] not in seen:
                    seen.add(event['eventID'])
                    CAP['cloudtrail']['events'].append({'phase': phase, 'first_observed_ms': ended, 'lookup_event_id': lookup_event['EventId'], 'event': event})
            token = output.get('NextToken')
            CAP['cloudtrail']['lookups'].append({'phase': phase, 'input': parameters, 'request_started_ms': started, 'response_observed_ms': ended, 'result_code': response['code'], 'returned_event_count': len(output.get('Events', [])), 'next_token': token, 'matched_owned_event_ids': matched_ids})
            if not token:
                break
    missing = []
    for phase in KEYS:
        for operation in ('GenerateDataKey', 'Decrypt'):
            if not any(item['phase'] == phase and item['event'].get('eventName') == operation and not item['event'].get('errorCode') and item['event'].get('requestParameters', {}).get('encryptionContext', {}).get('aws:sns:topicArn') == TOPIC for item in CAP['cloudtrail']['events']):
                missing.append(phase + ':' + operation)
    CAP['cloudtrail']['window']['missing_successful_operations'] = missing
    save()
    print('audit missing:', missing, flush=True)
    if not missing:
        break
    time.sleep(20)
CAP['cloudtrail']['window']['poll_finished_ms'] = now()
CAP['completed_ms'] = now()
save()
print('FINISHED', OUT, 'missing=', missing, flush=True)

import base64
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
sys.path.insert(0, '/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/scripts/aws')
from aws_cli import run, result

path = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/sns/encryption_s3_source.json')
cap = json.loads(path.read_text())
env = dict(os.environ, AWS_REGION=cap['region'], AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=cap['region'], AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1', AWS_PAGER='', AWS_IGNORE_CONFIGURED_ENDPOINT_URLS='true')
for key in list(env):
    if key.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL'):
        del env[key]
now = lambda: int(time.time() * 1000)
cap['source']['audit_completion_script'] = Path(__file__).read_text()
cap['source']['capture_execution_note'] = 'Initial capture completed publication and finally cleanup. Its ResourceName=key-ID audit loop was cancelled after a separate EventSource lookup located both successful KMS pairs; this completion script records the alternate lookup and verifies fixture correlations. Key-ID lookups returned administration events but did not return these crypto events in the observed polling interval.'
cap['cloudtrail']['window']['resource_name_poll_finished_ms'] = cap['cloudtrail']['lookups'][-1]['response_observed_ms']
parameters = {'LookupAttributes': [{'AttributeKey': 'EventSource', 'AttributeValue': 'kms.amazonaws.com'}], 'StartTime': cap['cloudtrail']['window']['start'], 'EndTime': cap['cloudtrail']['window']['end'], 'MaxResults': 50}
owned = {value['Arn']: phase for phase, value in cap['owned_resources']['keys'].items()}
seen = {item['event']['eventID'] for item in cap['cloudtrail']['events']}
while True:
    started = now()
    response = result(run('cloudtrail', 'lookup-events', parameters, env, options=['--no-paginate', '--cli-connect-timeout', '10', '--cli-read-timeout', '30'], timeout=45))
    ended = now()
    assert response['code'] == 'Success', response
    output = response['output']
    matched_ids = []
    for item in output.get('Events', []):
        event = json.loads(item['CloudTrailEvent'])
        phase = next((owned[r['ARN']] for r in event.get('resources', []) if r.get('ARN') in owned), None)
        if phase is None:
            continue
        matched_ids.append(event['eventID'])
        if event['eventID'] not in seen:
            seen.add(event['eventID'])
            cap['cloudtrail']['events'].append({'phase': phase, 'first_observed_ms': ended, 'lookup_event_id': item['EventId'], 'event': event})
    cap['cloudtrail']['lookups'].append({'input': dict(parameters), 'request_started_ms': started, 'response_observed_ms': ended, 'result_code': response['code'], 'returned_event_count': len(output.get('Events', [])), 'next_token': output.get('NextToken'), 'matched_owned_event_ids': matched_ids})
    if not output.get('NextToken'):
        break
    parameters['NextToken'] = output['NextToken']
cap['cloudtrail']['window']['poll_finished_ms'] = now()
cap['cloudtrail']['window']['missing_successful_operations'] = []
expected_context = {'aws:sns:sourceAccount': cap['account'], 'aws:sns:sourceArn': 'arn:aws:s3:::' + cap['owned_resources']['bucket'], 'aws:sns:topicArn': cap['owned_resources']['topic']}
cap['correlations'] = []
for phase in ('validation', 'object'):
    receipt = next(r for r in cap['receipts'] if r['phase'] == phase and r['correlated'])
    pairs = []
    for operation in ('GenerateDataKey', 'Decrypt'):
        events = [entry['event'] for entry in cap['cloudtrail']['events'] if entry['phase'] == phase and entry['event']['eventName'] == operation and not entry['event'].get('errorCode')]
        assert events, (phase, operation)
        for event in events:
            assert event['requestParameters']['encryptionContext'] == expected_context
            assert event['userIdentity'] == {'type': 'AWSService', 'invokedBy': 'sns.amazonaws.com'}
            assert event['sourceIPAddress'] == event['userAgent'] == 'sns.amazonaws.com'
            event_ms = int(dt.datetime.fromisoformat(event['eventTime'].replace('Z', '+00:00')).timestamp() * 1000)
            assert cap[phase + '_started_ms'] // 1000 * 1000 <= event_ms <= cap[phase + '_ended_ms']
            pairs.append(event['eventID'])
    cap['correlations'].append({'phase': phase, 'key_arn': cap['owned_resources']['keys'][phase]['Arn'], 'receipt_message_id': receipt['message']['MessageId'], 'kms_event_ids': pairs, 'window_started_ms': cap[phase + '_started_ms'], 'window_ended_ms': cap[phase + '_ended_ms'], 'kms_encryption_context': expected_context, 'audit_actor': 'sns.amazonaws.com', 'authorized_producer': 's3.amazonaws.com'})
body = cap['object']['body_utf8'].encode('utf-8')
assert body == base64.b64decode(cap['object']['body_base64'])
assert hashlib.md5(body).hexdigest() == cap['object']['body_md5'] == cap['object']['put_output']['ETag'].strip('"')
assert hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() == cap['object']['body_sha256']
assert len(body) == cap['object']['size']
put = next(o for o in cap['observations'] if o['operation'] == 'put-object')
assert put['input']['Body'].encode('utf-8') == body
object_receipt = next(r for r in cap['receipts'] if r['phase'] == 'object' and r['correlated'])
record = object_receipt['decoded_notification']['Records'][0]
assert record['s3']['object']['key'] == cap['object']['key']
assert record['s3']['object']['eTag'] == cap['object']['body_md5']
assert record['s3']['object']['size'] == len(body)
cap['correlations'][-1]['object_key'] = cap['object']['key']
cap['correlations'][-1]['etag'] = record['s3']['object']['eTag']
cap['correlations'][-1]['s3_notification_request_id'] = record['responseElements']['x-amz-request-id']
checks = {o['label']: o['result'] for o in cap['cleanup']}
assert checks['verify-bucket-absent']['code'] == '404'
assert checks['verify-topic-absent']['code'] == 'NotFound'
assert checks['verify-subscription-absent']['code'] == 'NotFound'
assert checks['verify-queue-absent']['code'] == 'AWS.SimpleQueueService.NonExistentQueue'
assert not checks['verify-owned-bucket-versions-empty']['output'].get('Versions')
assert not checks['verify-owned-bucket-versions-empty']['output'].get('DeleteMarkers')
assert not checks['verify-owned-bucket-objects-empty']['output'].get('Contents')
cap['cleanup_summary'] = {'bucket_topic_subscription_queue_absent': True, 'bucket_contents_and_versions_empty_before_deletion': True, 'keys': {}}
for phase in ('validation', 'object'):
    scheduled = checks['schedule-' + phase + '-key-deletion']['output']
    actual = checks['verify-' + phase + '-key-pending-deletion']['output']['KeyMetadata']
    assert actual['KeyState'] == 'PendingDeletion'
    assert actual['DeletionDate'] == scheduled['DeletionDate']
    assert scheduled['PendingWindowInDays'] == 7
    cap['cleanup_summary']['keys'][phase] = {'key_id': actual['KeyId'], 'state': actual['KeyState'], 'deletion_date': actual['DeletionDate']}
cap['verification'] = {'native_consumer_validation': True, 'native_consumer_object_created': True, 'separate_successful_kms_pair_per_key': True, 'second_key_used_only_for_real_object_publication': True, 'object_bytes_etag_size_and_receipt_correlated': True, 'verified_at_ms': now(), 'scope': 'Capture-data assertions and actual native operations only; no project validation.'}
cap['completed_ms'] = now()
def scrub(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {key: '<redacted>' if key.lower() in ('accesskeyid', 'secretaccesskey', 'sessiontoken') else scrub(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [scrub(item) for item in value]
    return value
path.write_text(json.dumps(scrub(cap), indent=2) + '\n')
